owner_note.text: Auth demo is merged into the one monorepo Worker; staging.lew42.com works except real Google sign-in. To finish you need to: (1) create a Google OAuth Web client with origins http://localhost:8787, https://staging.lew42.com, https://lew42.com and give me the client id; (2) enable R2 in Cloudflare; (3) tell me when to cut lew42.com over (needs a dashboard Git-builds change). Steps: worker/readme.md "What the owner must do". Production was NOT changed.
